{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rout of Spuma''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground]] victory on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spuma]] sometime before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The [[1st Tapani Assault Battlegroup]] triumphed in the engagement, earning a commemorative mention in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', courtesy of [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[High General]] [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]].
